t0404-01.gloss: A personal trace links farm-program residue to symptoms before a restriction.
t0404-01.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while crossing treated land; the personal trace does not by itself prove the farm program caused the emergency.

t0404-02.gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
t0404-02.rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
